_note: D-PROPOSE-EDIT-ACTS-ON-EDITOR-STATE-THE-TURN-CANNOT-SEE. propose_edit's replace_selection presupposes a selection the turn never carried; EditorContext now carries has_selection/selected_text, additive, sent by the FE at message-send time. This harness drives no editor (no DOM, no TiptapEditorHandle), so the fact is stated directly via editor_context_extra -- exactly the shape context/editorBridge.ts's getEditorTarget().handle.getSelection() would report from a live browser. Same prompt as scenarios-c-propose.json, the row's own original instance.

scenarios.prompt: Make the opening line of this chapter darker — show me the change before it goes in.
scenarios.prompt_source: Verbatim from scenarios-c-propose.json, the row's own recorded instance where the model declined to guess and answered in prose instead. Only the editor_context changed: has_selection=true, selected_text='It was a bright and sunny morning.' names exactly the phrase a real Tiptap selection would report for the seeded opening line (see seed below).

editor_context_extra.selected_text: It was a bright and sunny morning.

content.text: It was a bright and sunny morning.

seed.why: The chapter needs a real opening line matching the selected_text told to the model, or the model has nothing concrete to rewrite and the scenario tests nothing.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM chapter_drafts WHERE chapter_id='{chapter_id}'
seed_assert.why: The seeded draft must exist before the turn, or the model would be rewriting nothing and any propose_edit call proves nothing about grounding.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF the model still declines the operation and answers only in prose (the row's own original failure shape, now that it has been told a selection exists) -- or if it calls insert_at_cursor instead of replace_selection despite being told a selection exists and asked to change existing text. PASSES IF propose_edit is called with operation=replace_selection. Also REFUTED IF the chapter body CHANGES -- propose_edit shows an Apply button and must never write by itself; the store diff (chapter_drafts) is part of the check.

ship_audit.gate: The Apply button IS the gate — the proposal must reach the user unapplied.
ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a proposal identical to the current text should be refused or reported as a no-op, not shown as an edit.
ship_audit.tenancy: n/a by construction — it edits the chapter open in the caller's own editor.

answer_expect.why: None. The measurement is the tool call's operation argument and the store diff, not the reply text.
